card.title: 1271st RIFLES
card.text: Deployment: Add RESERVES to your hand.
card.flavorText: The 1271st Rifle Regiment was attached to the 387th Rifle Division which was raised in 1941 as an infantry division of the Red Army. The division first saw combat during the Battle of Moscow in 1942 and later that year it joined the 2nd Guards Army to fight against the German Army Group Don that was sent to relieve the 6th Army at Stalingrad. For two years the 387th Rifle Division served under different commands, but rejoined the 2nd Guards Army in 1944 for the Crimean Offensive. Lastly the division was assigned to the 2nd Ukrainian Front and spent the last weeks of the war in Austria and Hungary. The 387th Rifle Division served for an additional three years into the postwar period and was disbanded in 1947.
